hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; bunx prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; case "$f" in *.js|*.mjs|*.cjs|*.ts|*.svelte) out=$(bunx eslint --fix --no-warn-ignored "$f" 2>&1); [ -n "$out" ] && jq -n --arg msg "$out" '{hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PostToolUse", additionalContext: $msg}}' ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
